findings.summary: Clearing every role permission skips assignment authority.
findings.details: updateRole sees [] as truthy, calls assertCanAssignPermissions, which returns early on zero length; service persists []. A roles.update actor without roles.permissions.assign can remove all permissions. No last-admin availability or concurrent revision check found.

findings.summary: Organization currency/timezone/calendar inputs rely on compile-time types and permissive strings.
findings.details: Only name trimming validation is explicit in owner. Direct action input can bypass client selects. Currency and operating-date effects on established financial activity require exact domain review, not generic business approval claims.

findings.summary: Fresh-auth and committed-write recovery are incomplete in settings/role forms.
findings.details: Forms have no local password step-up. Revalidation failure is caught as mutation failure after organization/role commit. Role update can commit then fail reload. No safe same-command create retry identity found.

findings.summary: Organization profile refetch can replace an unsaved draft.
findings.details: Effect unconditionally resets all formData whenever query organization changes, with no dirty-state guard. Verify stale query focus/refetch while editing before correction.

findings.summary: Role mutation governance evidence is best effort after commit.
findings.details: logSecurityEvent swallows audit insert failures; unlike user deactivation there is no in-transaction before/after audit record for roles. Do not claim trustworthy durable role-change history from this code alone.

findings.summary: Member deactivation UI falsely claims deletion on rejected action.
findings.details: deleteUser returns a failure envelope; row callback resolves without throwing; generic action emits Deleted Successfully. Confirmation says irreversible physical deletion while owner deactivates and retains history. No write or browser attempt performed.
